thread_title: 🔥10000银芯奖励！V2.5 UGC创作征集开启！

content:
🥇 感谢大家热情的参与，我们收到了很多特别棒的作品！

经过了多轮评选后，诞生了最终的获奖名单

✦ 奖励会在<t:1789660799:f>前发到大家的邮箱~
一等奖的头像框如果以前获取过，在点击“领奖”后会自动转化成500银芯和50个追念羽笔
如果奖励方面有问题也请联系我。
✦ 注意：一些投稿者提供的链接失效/无法正常打开，咔哒无法查看作品，也没办法进行联系，因此我只能发放参与奖，敬请谅解。
也请大家投稿前确认一下链接能否正常点开，非常感谢~
✦ 投稿作品在线文档已更新<:Coalsie_shock:1516192103846383838> ：
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mKHzSaL4D-874UTS5Dm8QqFtO-JtUn3Gdo9vRtGDnGE/edit?usp=sharing

——✦——✦—— ✦✦✦ ——✦——✦——

🥇 Thank you all for your enthusiastic participation! We have received a lot of amazing works! After multiple rounds of selection, the final list of winners has been determined~

✦ The rewards will arrive in your inbox by midnight on<t:1789660799:f>.
If the first prize avatar box has been obtained before, it will automatically convert into 500 Silver and 50 Remembrance Quills after clicking "Award"
If there are any issues with the rewards, please also contact me.
✦ Note: Some of the links provided by a few contributors have become invalid or are inaccessible. Kada was unable to view these works, and there's no way to make contact either. Therefore, Kada can only distribute participation awards for these entries. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
✦ The online document for the submitted work has been updated<:Coalsie_shock:1516192103846383838> : 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mKHzSaL4D-874UTS5Dm8QqFtO-JtUn3Gdo9vRtGDnGE/edit?usp=sharing
